title: Barre VT Water Heater Rebates 2026: Heat Pump Units and Oil Homes
desc: Barre heat pump water heater rebates for 2026: $600 from Efficiency Vermont, up to $1,000 if income-eligible, in a city where 58% of homes burn oil.
h1: Water Heater Rebates in Barre, Vermont
lead: Barre burns more oil than any other city we cover (58% of homes). A heat pump water heater is a way to reduce that use for hot water, and Efficiency Vermont pays $600 toward it.
cards_heading: What pays for a heat pump water heater in Barre
cards_intro: We re-read Efficiency Vermont's heat pump water heater page, the utility pages that link to it and Burlington Electric's pages on October 5, 2026. Amounts are maximums.

cards.title: Efficiency Vermont heat pump water heater
cards.note: A $600 discount or rebate, plus $400 more for income-eligible households. Applies to qualifying heat pump water heaters (effective August 16, 2025).

cards.title: Green Mountain Power
cards.note: Green Mountain Power's page sends you to Efficiency Vermont for the rebate. GMP says a heat pump unit runs at about 550 watts while a standard electric water heater uses 4,500 watts.

cards.title: Home Energy Loan
cards.note: Efficiency Vermont lists a Home Energy Loan from 0% interest alongside its small-appliance rebates. Ask whether a water heater project qualifies.

after_cards: Efficiency Vermont lists the offer as up to $1,000 including the income-eligible extra.
sections: The Census Bureau's 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey shows 2,385 of Barre's 4,094 occupied homes (58%) heating mainly with oil, 627 (15%) with propane, 569 (14%) with electricity and 175 with wood. If your hot water comes from the oil boiler, a heat pump water heater lets you stop firing it in summer. That is a smaller project than a whole-home heat pump, and the Efficiency Vermont rebate is the same $600 either way.

2,032 of Barre's households rent and 2,062 own. 1,922 housing units are in buildings of two to nine units. A landlord who pays for the water heater and a tenant who pays for the oil have opposite incentives. Efficiency Vermont lists this rebate for residential properties, so ask whether an owner of a multi-unit building can claim it for each tank, a point we did not verify.

46% of Barre's housing units were built in 1939 or earlier, so many basements are old. Green Mountain Power says a heat pump water heater removes moisture from the air as it works. Whether your basement has space, a drain and a circuit is a question for the installer. Our Barre insulation guide covers the larger heat-loss problem in the same buildings.
The power draw, in plain numbers

Green Mountain Power says a heat pump water heater runs at about 550 watts against 4,500 watts for a standard electric water heater, roughly eight times less power while running. Barre's average January low is -11.9°C and its record low in 2015 to 2024 was -30.9°C. A unit that draws heat from the air in an unheated basement will have less to draw on in January, so ask the installer about the minimum room temperature for the model you are considering.

Both cities are Green Mountain Power territory with the same rebate. The difference is the fuel: Barre has more oil households and fewer wood and propane ones, so the water heater question is more likely to be about an oil boiler. Montpelier readers can see the Montpelier water heater guide.
claim_heading: How to claim a water heater rebate in Barre
claim_steps: Check which fuel heats your water today, and the age of the tank.
Choose a heat pump model on Efficiency Vermont's qualifying list and ask the installer to apply the discount on the invoice.
Confirm the installation spot has the space and drainage the unit needs.
If your income may qualify, ask Efficiency Vermont about the extra $400 before you order.
Keep the invoice and model number for your records.
faq: How much does Efficiency Vermont pay for a heat pump water heater in Barre?
$600, plus $400 more for income-eligible households, up to $1,000.
Can I stop using my oil boiler in summer?
If a heat pump unit makes your hot water, the boiler need not run for it. Ask your installer how your system is plumbed.
Is there a Barre city rebate?
We did not find one. The Efficiency Vermont offer is the one we verified.
What do I need to check before ordering?
Model on Efficiency Vermont's list, space and a drain, and an electric circuit.
Does the income bonus apply to landlords?
The heat pump water heater page lists an extra $400 for income-eligible households. We did not confirm how it treats landlords.
